integrity: The stated proof is analytic; exact verification checks finite enumerations only. Known deterministic center elimination and IAC counting methods are attributed to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite and limiting result for fixed-axis restricted IAC and odd electorates with three candidates; not independent votes, unrestricted IAC, more candidates, empirical prediction or independently certified priority.
title: An exact anonymous-culture center-squeeze law for single-peaked instant runoff
